title: 第112章 徐少阳影现第111章 冰湖骨阵下
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
;;
“你身上的证据味道，真让人讨厌。”
他左眼灰白一亮。
顾清寒执法令中的几枚证物竟同时震动。
第一炉口眼灰。
第二炉口验血判定。
第三炉口骨阵残气。
三样证物，都被徐少阳身上的炉性引动。
顾清寒脸色一沉，强行压住执法令。
徐少阳笑意更深。
“你看。”
“你封下的证据，也是炉的一部分。”
“你带着它们，就像带着炉口的眼睛。”
“总有一天，它们会反过来看你。”
顾清寒没有说话。
她只是将执法令收回袖中，换长剑正握。
周荒眼神微冷。
徐少阳现在最危险的地方，不是战力。
是他开始懂得用炉口的逻辑说话。
他知道怎么动摇顾清寒。

也知道怎么诱周荒硬拼。
这说明，他身上不只有徐少阳本人的恨。
还有乌先生，或者北冥主炉残意。
周荒抬手，服下一枚净火养脉丹。
骨寒被压下少许。
徐少阳看见丹药，眼里露出贪婪。
“丹堂给你的东西真多。”
周荒道：
“羡慕？”
徐少阳脸色扭曲了一瞬。
羡慕。
他当然羡慕。
曾经他是合欢堂内门，柳红绡座下利刃，人人看他都要让三分。
周荒那时候算什么？
一个废丹房爬出来的杂役。
可现在呢？
周荒筑基、入丹堂、得执法堂相助、三宗弟子跟着他破炉。
而他徐少阳，被黑炉当材料，被乌先生钉炉钉，被北冥主炉一点点改成鬼东西。
他恨周荒。
也恨乌先生。

更恨自己变成这样以后，第一件想做的事，竟然还是杀周荒。
徐少阳喉咙里发出一声低吼。

"The smell of evidence on your body is really annoying."
His left eye turned gray.
Several exhibits in Gu Qinghan's law enforcement order shook at the same time.
The first furnace mouth turned gray.
Second furnace entrance blood test determination.
The remaining energy of the third furnace mouth bone formation.
The three pieces of evidence were all attracted by Xu Shaoyang's burning nature.
Gu Qinghan's face darkened and he suppressed the law enforcement order forcefully.
Xu Shaoyang's smile deepened.
"Look."
"The evidence you sealed is also part of the furnace."
"You carry them like eyes on the hearth."
"One day, they will look back at you."
Gu Qinghan said nothing.
She just put the law enforcement order back in her sleeve and held the long sword in front of her.
Zhou Huang's eyes were slightly cold.
The most dangerous thing about Xu Shaoyang now is not his combat power.
It was he who began to know how to speak with the logic of the furnace mouth.
He knew how to shake Gu Qinghan.
He also knew how to lure Zhou Huang into a head-on fight.
This shows that there is more than Xu Shaoyang's own hatred in him.
There is also Mr. Wu, or Beiming Zhulu Canyi.
Zhou Huang raised his hand and took a Pure Fire Nourishing Pulse Pill.
The bone cold was suppressed a little.
Xu Shaoyang saw greed in his eyes.
"Dantang has given you so many things."
Zhou Huang said:
"Envy?"
Xu Shaoyang's face twisted for a moment.
envious.
Of course he was envious.
He used to be the inner sect of Hehuan Hall, and Liu Hongxiao had a sharp sword under his command. Everyone wanted to give him three points when they saw him.
Who was Zhou Huang back then?
A handyman who crawled out of an abandoned alchemy room.
But now?
Zhou Huang built the foundation, entered the Alchemy Hall, received help from the Law Enforcement Hall, and the disciples of the three sects followed him through the furnace.
And he, Xu Shaoyang, was used as a material by Hei Furnace, nailed by Mr. Wu, and turned into a ghost bit by bit by Beiming's main furnace.
He hated Zhou Huang.
I also hate Mr. Wu.
I hate that after I became like this, the first thing I wanted to do was to kill Zhou Huang.
Xu Shaoyang let out a low roar in his throat.
